title: Accounts nobody works with
prompt: Sales wants the accounts that no one is working with yet: known to the CRM, but with no contact person and no invoice. Write `solve(accounts, customer_cdc, contacts, invoices)` so it returns the `account_id` of each of them.
rules: An account is known if its `account_id` is in `accounts` (the snapshot) or in `customer_cdc` (accounts added or changed since).
Leave out every account whose id appears in `contacts` or in `invoices`.
Return one column, `account_id`, with each account once.
hints: Build two lists of ids: the known ones (snapshot and change feed) and the ones in use (contacts and invoices).
`union` stacks two one-column DataFrames into one list.
Then take the known ids that aren't in use with `subtract`, which also returns each one once.
